_meta.what: Real ages, positions and unions for women's players, each checked against a public source one player at a time. Anything in here is a FACT: scripts/tools/womens-ages.py never deals an age to a player listed with one, and never changes a position listed here.
_meta.why: The owner's squad sheet carried names and clubs. Position, age, nationality and rating were all assigned by the game, including for the 96 capped internationals whose positions the data file claimed were a matter of record. They were not. Owner: 'check the ages of the womens players against a Google search.'
_meta.ageRule: age = 2026 minus year of birth, which is the player's age through the 2026-27 season the database is set in
_meta.howToAdd: name, then any of age / pos / nat, and a src naming where it was checked. No entry without a source.
